title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Trio #11 (가로 띠·물결 / 세로 띠·매끈 / 대각 띠·물결)

Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare.
